betterquesting:10.desc:8:
Need to map biomes on a planet for terraforming? The §6Biome Scanner§f scans a 33x33 chunk area around itself and writes the biome map to a §6Data Unit§f.

Crafted in vanilla: Biome Changer satellite function, structure machine, tin plates, and batteries. Runs at 50 RF/t for 600 ticks (30 seconds) per scan. The Data Unit output loads into the §6Astrobody Data Processor§f for the Holographic Planet Selector.

The scanner shows the biome map as a colored grid in its GUI. For large-scale mapping, throw it on a minecart rail and run it through the area to cover hundreds of chunks in a single pass.

§ePS:§f Pair with a Warp Controller to transfer data to orbital stations. This is the foundation of the terraforming mission questline.
